description: The schedulable structure of one day in one venue: the time slots a gathering offers, before any proposal is programmed into them. One record per (day, venue). Written by the gathering actor. Successor of the time_slots table; the slot assignments themselves are schellingpoint.draft.slot records.

venue.description: The schellingpoint.draft.venue this grid belongs to. Absent for a venue-less grid (a fully virtual day).

day.description: Calendar date in the gathering's timezone, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD.

timezone.description: IANA zone the day is reckoned in.
